summary: Pinned 9.6.5 fork skips completed chunks on shared resume; desktop additionally retains the parent snapshot before enqueue consumes it. App task construction, real HTTP range workers, pause/resume, stitching, exact bytes and SHA-256 pass.

root_causes.finding: 9.6.5 resumes every serialized chunk. A completed chunk has a final file but no resume record, so its resume returns false and cancels the entire parent.
root_causes.fix: Filter only TaskStatus.complete out of resume calls; retain the full chunk snapshot and existing stitch behavior.

root_causes.finding: enqueue starts a real parent worker that consumes/deletes its resume record before resume reads it again.
root_causes.fix: Read the parent snapshot before enqueue, then pass that retained snapshot to resumeChunkTasks. No native changes.

root_causes.finding: Previous registrar comments had no actual registrar; default headless isolate fallback failed with Callbacks into Dart VM prohibited. Full Linux registration also attempted unavailable NetworkManager.
root_causes.fix: Actual engine entry-point registrar selects the real PathProviderLinux. Connectivity and persistence only are host fixtures.

red_evidence.finding: Unmodified pinned package: uninterrupted transfer passed; both completed-fast-chunk resumes returned false after proving one completed chunk/no resume record and two nonempty partial chunks.

After desktop ordering correction only, unfinished chunk workers actually resumed but parent resume still returned false. This isolates the shared completed-chunk defect. These early runs additionally hit fixture cleanup timeouts.

assertions: App createDirectDownloadTask selects ParallelDownloadTask with parallelDownloads=3.
Uninterrupted exactly three distinct expected GET ranges, simultaneous server handling peak=3, complete byte/hash equality.
Fast first range has its final on-disk file and its worker is no longer active before pause.
Both slow chunks have nonempty partial files before pause.
Actual parent resume JSON contains one completed chunk; completed chunk has no resume record; two unfinished chunks retain a strong ETag and nonzero offsets.
Parent resume returns true; final callback is complete after running/paused/running transitions.
Exactly five total GET ranges after resume: three originals and exactly two saved-offset continuations, no completed-range re-download.
Disk-JSON variant reconstitutes fresh paused Task/ResumeData objects before actual resume.
